_doc: Predictability Index formula constants — controls which Python functions get skeletonized

threshold.doc: PI >= threshold → function body is replaced with skeleton. Lower = more aggressive.

boilerplate_bonus.doc: PI bonus when simple_ratio >= simple_ratio_threshold AND complex_count == 0.

simple_ratio_threshold.doc: Fraction of lines that must be 'simple' (assign/return/pass) to earn boilerplate_bonus.

loop_free_bonus.doc: Additional bonus when function has > 20 lines AND zero complex constructs.

complexity_penalty_cap.doc: Maximum total complexity penalty (cap on loop_penalty * count).
